node.title: XR trade circuits have bounded arity and rank-two Segre atlas
node.statement: A support-minimal row-scaling trade of rank r in a uniform split pencil has r+2<=t<=2r+1 active blocks, and every trade decomposes into such circuits of no larger rank. Since rank one is impossible, every rank-two trade decomposes into circuits on exactly four or five blocks. Their coefficient columns lie on the Segre quadric in P^3: four-block circuits are Mobius/Plucker graphs of rank three, while five-block circuits have rank four with every four columns independent. This removes arbitrary block arity from the proper local rank-two frontier; this node does not itself supply ownership or aggregate payment of the two constant-arity classes.
